records.name: Ember Spikes
records.description: Reactive damage with a small burn chance on hit.

records.name: Warmth
records.description: Removes cold or water debuffs and grants minor regeneration.

records.name: Waterbreath
records.description: Allows underwater breathing and improves aquatic efficiency.

records.name: Mend
records.description: Restores a small amount of health.

records.name: Shock
records.description: Increases interrupt chance and disrupts actions.

records.name: Surge
records.description: Restores health with a quick burst.

records.name: Preserve
records.description: Stabilizes health and prevents further loss.

records.name: Restore

records.name: Vinebind
records.description: Restrains movement more strongly than root.

records.name: Berry
records.description: Generates charge-based consumable healing berries usable only by caster and party.

records.name: Smoke
records.description: Creates obscured area and breaks targeting.
